quotes.quote: The close grip lat pulldown is a lat pulldown variation which is performed with a close grip by using a v handle attachment.
Attatch a grip to the lat pulldown that lets you have a neutral close-grip.
adjusting the pads so they sit tightly against your thighs when you are seated.
Sit in the machine, anchoring your lower extremity by adjusting the thigh pad to fit firmly against the top of your thighs.
Lean back slightly (no more than a 30 degree angle), using your legs to support your body (low back).
Avoid any additional backwards lean during the pull movement.
think about pulling your elbows down towards your hips until your upper arms are tucked either side of your torso and the v handle reaches just below the chin.
Pulling the grip down too low will force your forearms and deltoids to take over, shifting the load away from your lats and biceps and making the shoulders exposed to injury.
Continue pulling until the bar nears or touches your chest, or more importantly, you observe your elbows no longer moving downward, but now beginning to move backwards.
Avoid any further pulling as this places additiomnal stresses into the shoulder joint.
Move the weight with control rather than using momentum to ensure the correct muscles are worked.
initiate the downward pull by first depressing (lower) your scapulae
